name: NYU Stern LARA
outcome: From discovering the organization to finding a reason to join.

caseStudy.problem: Prospective members need to understand what LARA does and see where they fit. A clear introduction matters as much as the first impression.
caseStudy.whatWeBuilt: An organization website with a dedicated programming showcase. A clear hierarchy puts the group’s purpose and activities within easy reach on desktop and mobile.
caseStudy.results: Help visitors picture themselves taking part. Bring the organization’s purpose and programming together so interest has somewhere to go.
